<a id="cafe-thirteen-camera-angles"></a>

## One Cafe Take Re-Shot From Thirteen Camera Angles

[![Seedance 2.5 comparison of an original cafe take and a re-shot camera angle](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2102364937355923456/img/6Zj_tkPWGn0K1EFh.jpg>)](<https://x.com/Scenario_gg/status/2102365054389899695>)

A video-to-video workflow preserves one cafe performance while re-photographing it from thirteen timed camera positions.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video-to-video prompt · `en`

```text
ONE FINISHED TAKE, RE-PHOTOGRAPHED

@video1 is one finished take: a single locked-off wide, 19.53 s, with its original audio, a young man at an outdoor cafe table talking to one camera. Do not restage, re-perform, re-time or reinterpret it. Re-photograph the identical event from thirteen new camera positions, as if thirteen extra cameras had been rolling around him in the same moment. Every output frame shows the same body at the same instant of @video1 at the same speed. Output runs the full 19.53 s. Keep the audio of @video1 unchanged and in sync.

DO NOT CHANGE
Performance, body, hands and what they hold, head angle, eyeline, lip movement, blink timing, movement speed, action start and end times, lighting, exposure, white balance, colour grade, wardrobe, props, set. The only variable is camera position and lens.

SPEECH WINDOWS (measured from the audio of @video1)
SPEAKING: 0.00-1.65, 2.05-4.80, 5.95-6.90, 9.65-11.75, 12.20-12.85, 13.35-13.80, 16.70-16.90, 17.60-18.90.
SILENT, mouth closed and still or chewing: 1.65-2.05, 4.80-5.95, 6.90-9.65 (drinking), 11.75-12.20, 12.85-13.35, 13.80-16.70 (chewing), 16.90-17.60, 18.90-19.55.
Whenever his mouth is visible in a SPEAKING window it moves in lip-sync with the audio of @video1. He talks while looking down: from 2.05 to 4.80 his head is down at the laptop and he is speaking. Head down is not silent. Never add speech to a silent window, never mute a speaking one.

EYELINE RULE
He performed to ONE camera, the A-camera: the original locked-off wide, directly in front of him at seated eye level. His eyeline stays on that spot in every shot, apart from the glances down at keyboard, mug and pastry already in @video1. He never looks for or turns toward a new camera. From above he reads cap and brow; from the sides, three-quarter or profile; from behind, the back of his head. Single exception: the on-axis shot at 00:01-00:02 sits where the A-camera was, so there alone he looks into the lens.

TEMPO RULE
Real time, 1:1 with @video1. No speed ramps, added slow motion, freeze frames or time remaps. Exactly one slowed passage exists, already baked into the source: the pastry at the top of its arc, 12.5-13.55. Reproduce it at the speed it already has, no slower, no longer.

TOSS TIMING
The pastry leaves his fingers at 12.43 and is caught at 13.60: airborne about one second only. Do not stretch, loop or hang the flight. Before 12.43 and after 13.60 it is in his hand.

EMPTY SKY
On every low or upward-tilting shot the sky is plain pale overcast and empty. No skyscrapers, glass towers, solar panels, cranes, birds, aircraft, sun disc, structured clouds, lens flare or signage. Above his head only cream wall, white pillars and flat pale sky.

CAMERA PLAN

[00:00-00:01] High-angle MCU from above and to his right, about 40 degrees down, chest up, slow push-in, 35mm feel, moderate depth of field, cap brim and open gesturing palms, marble edge in the lower foreground. Speaking, reading three-quarter, not to this lens.

[00:01-00:02] ON THE A-CAMERA AXIS. ECU of his face, dead front, seated eye level, 85mm feel, shallow focus, pillars soft cream behind. The one shot where he looks into the lens. Hands drop below frame onto the keyboard; mouth closes at 1.65.

[00:02-00:05] Macro along the MacBook keyboard to his typing fingers, lens centimetres above the keys, razor-thin focus, keycaps sharp, his face soft far behind, head down. Speaking 2.05-4.80: where his mouth shows in the blur it moves with the audio. Fingers lift at 5.0.

[00:05-00:06] Top-down bird's eye straight down over the table, 24mm feel, deep focus, locked off. Marble disc fills frame: open laptop, white mug, financier, his cap at the bottom edge. Right hand crosses to the mug handle.

[00:06-00:07] Lens resting on the marble at table height, 50mm feel. White mug large and sharp in the left foreground; his hand enters from the right, grips the handle, lifts the mug up out of frame. Torso soft behind. Speaking 5.95-6.90.

[00:07-00:09] First-person POV from his seat, ultra-wide 18mm feel, gentle handheld breathing. The mug rim rises into the bottom of frame and tips toward the lens; laptop screen and marble beyond in deep focus. No face; framing dips to the mug, never up. Silent.

[00:09-00:10] Extreme wide, slow dolly out, 24mm feel, deep focus. He is small at his table mid-terrace: cream wall, pillars, concentric-circle mural, taped boxes behind, slatted bench visible. He sets the mug on the marble 9.4-10.0; speech resumes 9.65.

[00:10-00:12] Low and to his left, lens just above the marble, 50mm feel, shallow focus, table edge and mug soft in the near foreground. Right hand reaches out at 10.5 and lifts the golden financier into sharp focus before his left profile. Talking to the A-camera: full profile here.

[00:12-00:14] Low beside him, 35mm feel, slight Dutch. Opens on the pastry in his fingers; at 12.43 it leaves his hand and the camera tilts UP, following it against plain pale overcast sky and the top of a white pillar through the baked-in slow apex 12.5-13.55, then tilts DOWN for the catch at 13.60 into cupped hands, head tipped back, mouth open, then head coming forward.

[00:14-00:15] Behind him, over his right shoulder, 50mm feel, moderate focus. Back of the black Yankees cap and long dark hair fill frame-left; laptop glow and marble past his shoulder. Head settles level, hands bring the pastry toward his mouth. No face. Silent.

[00:15-00:16] ECU on his mouth and jaw, 100mm macro feel, very shallow focus, soft open-sky light. The financier enters from below, he bites, crumbs, the jaw chews. Chewing, not speaking. Nothing above the nose in frame.

[00:16-00:18] Slow orbit from his left toward front, 35mm feel, moderate focus, mural and pillars parallaxing behind, table crossing the foreground. He chews, speaks 16.70-16.90 and from 17.60, open palms, a small shrug. As the orbit nears front his gaze lands near, not into, this moving lens.

[00:18-00:20] Top-down bird's eye straight down over the table, 24mm feel, deep focus, locked off. Hands come down beside the laptop and settle, cap centred, speech ends 18.90, then still. Hold to 19.53.

SET AND SUBJECT CONTINUITY (identical in every shot)
Young man, long dark hair, black short-sleeve button-up shirt with a small chest logo, black New York Yankees baseball cap, grey trousers. Light wood slatted bench, round white marble table, outdoor cafe terrace. On the table: open dark grey MacBook, white mug with a circular graphic, one small golden financier. Behind him: cream wall, white cylindrical pillars, large black-and-white concentric-circle mural, taped cardboard boxes. Soft overcast open-shade daylight, no hard shadows, constant direction and softness. Warm bright grade: cream walls, golden wood, neutral white marble, warm skin, deep neutral blacks. He is alone; no passers-by, no staff.

No on-screen text, captions, subtitles, watermarks or logos beyond the small chest logo and cap emblem already in @video1.
```

### How to adapt it

Replace @video1 and remeasure every action and speech window. Keep the performance locked while changing only the camera position and lens plan.

## POPBOT Toy-City Mech Boss Battle

[![POPBOT character fighting a giant toy mech in a Seedance 2.5 video](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2084525436281958400/img/Fu80w4K3KjbIRJUg.jpg>)](<https://x.com/Mayz1169/status/2084530475792753069>)

A 30-second continuous anime-inspired boss fight keeps a locked character design moving across a giant toy mech.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video prompt · `en`

```text
Toy-world giant boss battle CG, 30 seconds, one continuous unbroken take, seamless continuation from the previous shot. No scene reset, no intro, no establishing shot, no pause, no boss defeat pose. The first frame must continue from the previous ending: POPBOT PRO is already standing on the giant mech titan’s chest armor platform, facing its glowing head at extreme close range above a massive toy city. Camera movement, lighting, character pose, wind, and momentum must continue seamlessly from the previous shot.

Character lock (no changes):
A small agile girl POPBOT PRO with long silver-white hair, loose twin tails, pale blue-grey eyes, pink X bandage on her cheek, focused expression. Blue bunny-ear cap with pink inner ears and goggles, black and hot pink headphones, oversized cobalt blue bomber jacket with bunny patch and X badges, white cropped top, black shorts, white utility belt, mismatched socks, blue-yellow-pink platform sneakers. She carries a huge cobalt blue, yellow and black toy cannon with pink handle and X markings. Color palette locked: hot pink, yellow, cobalt blue, white, black, grey.

Boss lock:
A hundred-meter toy titan mech made of glossy plastic and diecast materials, huge mechanical fists, chunky joints, visible screws and molded seams. Deep grey and matte blue armor, blue helmet with hot pink crest, glowing yellow eye visor, shoulder missile pods, pink-yellow energy lines, glowing chest core.

Environment:
A giant toy city battlefield with colorful building blocks, gift boxes, toy trains, Ferris wheels, carousels, teddy bears, scattered plastic debris. Realistic grey-white skyscrapers in the background, bright blue sky, clouds, colorful confetti floating through the air.

Timeline:

0.0–5.0s | Face-off on the titan
Continue directly from the previous frame. POPBOT stands on the titan’s chest armor, wind blasting through her hair and jacket. She grips her cannon, pulls down her cap, and aims toward the glowing mech head at point-blank range. The titan’s yellow eye visor narrows and intensifies. The mech suddenly raises its head and opens missile pods.

Camera: low-angle push-in from her feet toward her face, shallow depth of field, titan head glowing behind her.

5.0–10.0s | Missile counterattack
The titan launches multiple missiles. POPBOT instantly sprints across the tilted chest armor plates, dodging explosions and mechanical traps. Missiles chase her through the air, smashing toy structures and sending colorful plastic debris everywhere. She jumps between armor gaps while maintaining full speed.

Camera: fast side tracking shot, wide lens, heavy motion blur, explosions crossing the foreground.

10.0–15.0s | Airborne cannon attack
A missile explosion launches her into the air. She spins through the shockwave, stabilizes herself, and fires her giant cannon mid-air. A blue-white energy blast with pink trails destroys the incoming missiles in a chain reaction of colorful explosions above the toy city.

Camera: fast 360-degree orbit around her, toy city rotating below, energetic VFX filling the frame.

15.0–20.0s | Titan arm assault
She lands on the titan’s forearm and immediately charges toward its head. The mech swings its giant fist, but she slides underneath, jumps across moving armor plates, and runs upward along its arm while firing at exposed joints. The titan releases drones and smaller toy machines from hidden panels.

Camera: low perspective following her movement along the massive arm, extreme scale contrast.

20.0–25.0s | Climb to the final strike
POPBOT jumps from the shoulder armor onto the helmet crest. She plants her feet above the glowing eye visor and connects her cannon directly to the mech’s head. The weapon charges with blue, yellow and pink energy. The titan struggles, firing lasers and missiles around her, but she holds position.

Camera: rising crane movement around the titan’s body, revealing the entire toy metropolis battlefield.

25.0–30.0s | Energy blast and continuation
POPBOT fires a massive close-range energy beam into the titan’s head. The helmet cracks, colorful energy bursts through the seams, and the mech begins breaking apart into thousands of flying toy blocks and plastic pieces. She jumps through the falling debris, landing on a giant block while still moving forward.

End frame:
No victory pose, no freeze frame, no explosion ending. The camera follows her momentum into the falling toy debris, cutting during action.

Style:
AAA game boss battle trailer quality, stylized anime-inspired 3D CG, glossy toy materials, Ratchet & Clank + Astro Bot + Hi-Fi Rush feeling. High saturation colors, cinematic lighting, strong rim light, realistic reflections, physical debris simulation, colorful energy effects, constant motion blur, dynamic camera movement, 24fps anamorphic widescreen.

Negative:
Static camera, slow pacing, scene reset, character redesign, hair color change, costume change, weapon change, extra limbs, distorted face, bad hands, subtitles, text, watermark, UI, realistic military weapons, gore, dark desaturated colors, black screen, slow-motion ending.

Audio:
Fast-paced electronic rock with heavy drums, synth brass, toy-box chimes, mechanical servo sounds, missile launches, cannon charging, energy beam impact, plastic destruction sounds. Music keeps building and cuts off mid-action.
```

### How to adapt it

Replace the character sheet, boss design, and toy-city palette together. Preserve the timed escalation, scale contrast, character lock, and continuous forward momentum.

## Teleport-Speed Duel in a Ruined Temple

[![Two stylized fighters facing off in a Seedance 2.5 ruined-temple duel](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HS0sRvWaAAA0e4W.jpg>)](<https://x.com/GlitterPixely/status/2102385042529845450>)

Two stylized fighters trade teleport attacks through a 30-second temple battle with locked identities, dialogue, and sound cues.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

```text
Asset mapping:
@Image 1 defines Character A only: face, sharp amber-brown eyes, thick black eyebrows, freckles, facial scratches, black hair in a messy top knot with long thick braids, torn cream knit crop top with rust-red diamond band, bandage-wrapped left arm, midriff, rust sash. Ignore @Image 1 background, pose, and lighting.
@Image 2 defines Character B only: face, pointed elf ears with hoop, blue-grey eyes, heavy freckles, blush, platinum-blonde hair with two long front braids and red ties, rustic fur-trimmed top, red arm bands, shoulder marks. Ignore @Image 2 forest background, pose, and lighting.

One-sentence brief:
A 30-second teleport-speed fight between Character A and Character B in a ruined sunlit temple courtyard, shot with crash zooms, whip pans, orbits, tracking follows, and impact shake. Both land hits and get visibly annoyed.

0–5s — stare-down:
Wide low-angle courtyard of cracked stone platforms, collapsed pillars, drifting dust, golden backlight. A left, B right, ten paces apart. Both already irritated. Slow push-in between them, then a hard snap to a split close-up of their eyes. A’s glare tightens. B’s mouth flattens. Hair and cloth move. No attack yet. No dialogue yet.

5–11s — first exchange:
A vanishes in a black-red afterimage and reappears at B’s flank with a crimson kinetic punch that leaves a shock-ring in the air. A says {Too slow.}
B dissolves into pale petals and wind, reappears above A, and slashes a cutting gust that scores the stone. B says {Try again.}
Camera: handheld crash-zoom into the punch, whip-pan to B’s vanish, orbit the empty space, then track them as they ricochet across platforms. Afterimage-smeared, snappy, not floaty. Sparks, dust, and torn petals hang in the light.

11–17s — first real tags:
A’s fist clips B’s marked shoulder. B jolts; eyes flash wide then narrow hard; lip curls; she is pissed it landed. She answers instantly. A wind-blade grazes A’s cheek and knocks a braid sideways. A’s eyebrows slam down, jaw clenches, she scoffs and rolls her shoulder like the hit was an insult. A says {Lucky.}
B’s eyes narrow. B says {Say that again.}
Rapid cuts: impact close-up on B’s shoulder, smash-cut to A’s cut cheek, low-angle two-shot as they blink-step past each other. Each teleport pops a shockwave in the dust.

17–24s — second wind, arena breaks:
They stop pretending it was a probe. A slams a platform; stone lifts and she rides the shockwave into a three-blink rush, fists leaving stacked crimson afterimages. B answers by spinning a petal cyclone that shears a pillar in half; fragments hang, then fall. They bounce off walls, columns, and floating slabs. No new dialogue. Camera: FPV chase through a teleport, whip to a low tracking shot across rubble, crash-zoom on a near-miss, then a rising orbit as the courtyard starts coming apart. Both faces stay readable: A snarling, B glaring, sweat and grit on skin.

24–30s — clash and hold:
They collide mid-air over the broken courtyard. A’s crimson burst slams into B’s spinning wind-petal cyclone. Camera spirals up around them, then slams into a close two-shot as they lock, faces inches apart, breathing hard, both annoyed rather than triumphant. Final hold: A snarling, B glaring, sparks and petals falling between them. End on that locked stare. Hold the last frame.

Maintain consistency:
Exactly two characters. Do not blend faces, hair, outfits, or body types. Keep A’s bandage arm, crop top, black braids, freckles, and scratches. Keep B’s pointed ears, blonde braids, fur trim, freckles, and blush. Same ruined temple courtyard the whole clip. Stylized cinematic 3D-anime, sharp faces, volumetric golden dust light, readable silhouettes during speed. No extra fighters, no text, no logos, no subtitles, no watermarks.

Audio:
(tense percussion and low strings; drums tighten at 11s; full surge at 17s; cut almost dry on the final lock)
<stone crack, air-rip teleports, afterimage whoosh, fist impact, wind-blade slice, cloth snap, pillar shear, grit skidding, mid-air boom>
A, sharp and cocky: {Too slow.}
B, clipped and annoyed: {Try again.}
A, scoffing: {Lucky.}
B, low and pissed: {Say that again.}
Courtyard wind and settling rubble under everything. No crowd. No narrator.
```

### How to adapt it

Replace both character references and their paired effect languages together. Preserve the five timed beats, readable silhouettes, two-character limit, and final locked stare.

<a id="infinite-castle-sword-rush"></a>

## Infinite-Castle Sword Rush Through a Demon Army

[![Painted Seedance 2.5 sword fighter battling a dense demon army](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2102580215591636992/img/iI2V5ZpbjMvp2qWj.jpg>)](<https://x.com/Chengzilhy/status/2102586866302345657>)

A 30-second painted-animation battle maps one swordsman's route through hundreds of enemies across ten tightly timed shots.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

```text
【基础设定】

30秒，16:9。暗色幻想绘画动画风格，粗粝厚涂笔触、硬边明暗、概括色块、清晰人物剪影。

人物、敌群、建筑、武器统一为具有立体空间感的绘画动画。

高速运动中保持人物、刀锋、命中位置清楚。

头发、衣摆、碎木、灰烬具有真实惯性与重量。

整体色调以墨黑、灰青、旧木褐为主，人物暗红服装作为主要识别色。

【参考图绑定】
图片1= 战场建筑与空间结构参考。
仅采用悬空木平台、栏杆、回廊、阶梯、大殿及上下交错建筑关系。
图片2 = 敌群外观参考。
提取不同体型、皮肤、眼睛、獠牙、长爪、破旧衣物与异化轮廓，扩展为高密度敌潮。
图片3= 主角唯一身份与服装参考。
锁定脸型、长发、暗红外衣、敞领、腰带、宽裤、绑腿与鞋履。

【角色规则】

全片始终只有一名主角。
始终使用同一把实体刀，刀鞘固定腰侧。

右手主握，重斩时左手辅助同一刀柄。

人物面部克制，视线始终寻找下一处敌阵缺口。

所有攻击必须由真实身体动作驱动：

蹬地 → 转髋 → 挥刀 → 回腕 → 连续落步。

高速移动过程中人物本体始终连续可追踪。

禁止瞬移。

禁止实体分身。

禁止第二把刀。

【敌群规则】

敌人数百只。

中央平台、两侧回廊、远端阶梯与建筑阴影始终存在大量敌人。

前景使用肩背、头部、爪子压住画面边缘。

中景多排敌人包围人物移动路线。

背景敌群一直延伸至建筑深处。

敌人必须持续：

扑入、夹击、绕侧、封路、补位。

人物移动到哪里，新的敌群就从前方与侧翼压入。

人物经过之后才允许留下局部缺口。

24秒之前禁止大面积清空战场。

【核心战斗逻辑】

模式：

流光割草 + 极限连招密度。

全片以：

高速穿群
移动旋斩
横扫
反手斩
斜劈
短跃下劈

作为主要动作。

目标约26组短连招。

每组动作必须：

起手 → 接招 → 收招，无缝连接。

上一刀的收刀方向，直接成为下一组攻击的起始方向。

禁止攻击后站住重新摆姿势。

禁止三刀打一组然后停顿。

人物始终边打边移动。
【空间规则】
主平台远端阶梯 = 北。
入口 = 南。
左右两侧分别为东、西。
人物移动路线：

南部
→ 东侧
→ 中央
→ 西侧
→ 北部。

摄影机始终朝向尚未清除的敌群推进。

人物身前必须持续存在新的敌阵。

身后逐渐形成已经战斗过的路径。

空间、建筑地标、人物方向必须保持连续。

【镜头结构】

全片10个镜头段。

每段约3秒。

Shot 1｜0–3s

Wide，高位斜俯视追踪。

人物直接高速切入右侧敌群。

突入横斩
→ 反手回切
→ 移动回旋
→ 再次斜切进入下一排。

没有登场。

没有拔刀。

没有蓄力。
第一秒直接进入战斗。
Shot 2｜3–6s
FS，贴地侧前跟拍。
人物沿东侧战区高速向北推进。

连续横扫、反手斩、斜劈。

敌人从正面和侧面不断补入。

摄影机倒退跟拍，同时保留前方大量敌群。

Shot 3｜6–9s

Wide，升高斜俯视追踪。

人物从东侧切向平台中央。

连续三组移动旋斩。

每一次旋转都改变人物所在位置。

禁止原地转圈。

镜头展示人物身后逐渐形成的战斗路线。

Shot 4｜9–12s

FS，低位跟进。
人物进入中央最密集敌阵。
横扫
→ 反撩
→ 斜切
→ 上挑
→ 踏进压斩
→ 短跃下劈。
上层回廊与地面敌人同时压入。

人物必须同时应对上下两个方向。

Shot 5｜12–15s

FS，侧面短弧环绕。

人物折向西侧。

移动旋斩
→ 短跃
→ 下劈
→ 落地反手横扫。

完成后立即进入下一群敌人。

禁止落地停顿。

Shot 6｜15–18s

Wide，斜俯视折返追踪。

人物切进西侧敌阵后向北折返。

连续横斩、反斩、回旋压斩。

新的敌群从西侧回廊持续补入。

北侧阶梯始终作为远处空间地标。

Shot 7｜18–21s

MS → FS。

先短暂靠近人物。

展示一次真实的近距离攻防：

敌人双爪封路。

人物低身闪开攻击，同时转髋反切。

随后镜头立即拉开。

继续展示范围穿群动作。

禁止变成单挑。

Shot 8｜21–24s

Wide。
人物进入北部中央区域。
沿敌潮内部连续折线移动。
斜切进入
→ 回旋扫开
→ 反手穿出
→ 再改变方向。
东西两侧残余敌群继续向中心补位。
Shot 9｜24–27s

FS → Wide。

人物切入最后的大规模密集敌阵。

横扫
→ 反手斩
→ 压斩
→ 回旋
→ 反撩
→ 前冲斜劈。

镜头逐渐拉开。

明确展示人物已经打通的路线，与前方最后敌阵的位置。

Shot 10｜27–30s

FS → Wide。
人物冲入北阶前最后一批敌人。
27–28秒完成最后一组连续攻击。
28秒后停止攻击。

刀尖自然随收势垂下。

镜头缓慢后拉。

展示整个已经清理完成的平台。

主角成为画面中唯一站立的人物。

衣摆、长发、灰烬、碎屑继续自然运动。

【摄影规则】

摄影机必须跟随：

人物移动路线
攻击方向
敌群变化
空间地标。

远景与全景负责展示敌潮规模。

中近景只用于短暂展示身体动作与刀锋。

禁止长期贴脸。

禁止把范围战斗拍成逐个单挑。

禁止依靠疯狂切镜制造速度。

速度必须来自：

人物移动
敌群运动
身体动作
前景掠过
摄影机追踪。

【声音】

No dialogue.

No battle cries.

No subtitles.

No background music.

保留：
脚步声
挥刀声
撞击声
木构破裂声
环境空间回响。
```

A published 15-second prompt stages a golden retriever, a boy, and two puppies in a continuous backyard birthday story.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video prompt · `en`

```text
Create a 15-second photorealistic, heartwarming animal story in one continuous shot. Use a close-focusing 18mm wide-angle perspective with a fast, low, animal-height camera that smoothly rises into intimate human reactions without cutting. Maintain realistic animal movement, natural fur, believable object contact, and continuous spatial geography.

Set the sequence in one cozy backyard patio beside a small garden shed on a bright late-afternoon day. A wooden picnic table, two garden chairs, and a small covered dog bed occupy the same connected space.

The main animal is one golden retriever mother. The human character is a young boy wearing a mustard-yellow sweater. The important prop is one small round birthday cake with white frosting and a single blue candle.

0 to 2 seconds: Start extremely close to the cake on the picnic table. The mother dog reaches up, gently grips the cake box edge with her mouth, and pulls it down. The box lands softly on the patio. She immediately picks it up and trots away.

2 to 4 seconds: Race backward ahead of the dog as the boy notices. He follows with a surprised expression and says, “Hey, that’s for my birthday!”

4 to 6 seconds: Move alongside the dog as she passes between the two garden chairs. The camera stays low. The cake box bumps lightly against the ground with each step while the boy follows naturally behind.

6 to 8 seconds: Curve around the final chair and reveal the covered dog bed. The mother dog reaches it and carefully lowers the cake beside the bed. She releases the box and looks toward the puppies.

8 to 10 seconds: The first puppy slowly crawls forward from inside the bed and rests its chin beside the cake box. The boy kneels down, confused but smiling.

10 to 12 seconds: Rise slightly to include the boy, mother dog, and bed. The boy opens the box and discovers several tiny puppies gathered inside. He softly says, “Oh… you wanted a party too.”

12 to 14 seconds: Continue a close flowing orbit. The mother dog gently nudges the cake toward the puppies while the boy places it safely outside their reach. The puppies wiggle excitedly.

14 to 15 seconds: A second puppy suddenly pops its head beside the first and gives the blue candle one tiny curious sniff. The boy laughs quietly. End with the mother dog, two puppies, and boy sharing the warm moment.

Audio: Speak only the two quoted lines. Include soft paw steps, cardboard movement, quiet garden birds, puppy sounds, and the boy’s gentle laugh. No narration and no talking animals.

Continuity restrictions: One mother dog, exactly two puppies, one boy, one cake, one patio. No cuts, duplicated puppies, disappearing objects, magical movement, humanlike animal gestures, candle touching the puppies, or sudden location changes.
```

## What Can I Offer You? A Letterbox Pop-Out Comedy

[![What Can I Offer You? A Letterbox Pop-Out Comedy — Seedance 2.5 video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2106393512597913600/img/Nht5nvI8YPv9arQF.jpg>)](<https://x.com/aimikoda/status/2106393688653922602>)

A magician offers gifts and steps across static letterbox bars in a nonverbal anime comedy with a published reference-based prompt.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video prompt · `en`

```text
Use @[char ref] as the exact character and style reference. Preserve her long pale-blue hair, oversized blue-and-orange pointed magician hat, orange-and-blue coat with its circular sleeve emblem, blue knee-high socks and chunky orange-and-blue sneakers. Keep the same angular painterly anime rendering, sharp graphic shapes and character proportions. Replace the background with clean pure white.

Create a playful, completely nonverbal comedy in one continuous shot. She offers increasingly surprising gifts to the viewer, reacts to each implied rejection through expressive facial acting, then decides to step out of the picture herself.

MAIN VISUAL GOAL:
An unmistakable OUT-OF-FRAME, POP-OUT effect. Her offered objects, hands, sleeves, hat and finally her legs and body visibly project OVER the black letterbox bars toward the viewer.

COMPOSITING ORDER, BACK TO FRONT:

1. White background and scene.
2. Two broad black letterbox bars at the top and bottom.
3. The foreground character and the objects she presents.

The white background is confined to the central picture window. The foreground character and offered objects are NOT confined to that window. Their silhouettes continue uninterrupted across its boundaries and onto the black bars. Their original colors remain fully visible when overlapping black.

STATIC BARS, MOVING FOREGROUND:
Both bars are completely static screen graphics. Keep their equal thickness, full width and exact screen position unchanged throughout. Their inner boundaries remain perfectly straight and horizontal.
Foreground movement only temporarily hides portions of the bars. The underlying bars never move or deform. Visible edge segments on either side of an overlap remain aligned on the same horizontal line. When an object withdraws, reveal the original unchanged black surface beneath it.
Keep black visible beside the overlaps. No bending, sliding, shaking, stretching, opening or impact reactions. The bars remain unchanged even during the final step out of the picture.

CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE:
Stationary camera, fixed wide-angle lens and level framing. She stays close and prominent throughout. Keep her face clearly visible inside the central picture window while her hands and gifts extend over the lower bar.
Her facial acting remains continuously active: eye contact, eyebrow changes, natural blinking, questioning head tilts, shifting smiles, pouts and expressive cheek movements. Connect every reaction to the current offer.
The viewer remains unseen and silent. Every rejection is IMPLIED entirely by her own reaction after looking into the lens. No viewer hands, camera nodding or external rejection signals.

STRICTLY NONVERBAL:

No dialogue, spoken words, whispering, narration, lip-sync or human vocalizations. No subtitles, captions or speech bubbles. She never mouths sentences. Mouth movement is limited to natural nonverbal expressions.
Follow this exact order: FLOWER, COFFEE, JEWEL, CAT, HERSELF.

FIRST OFFER, FLOWER:

She smiles warmly and retrieves a single flower from beyond a side edge of the screen. Extend it toward the viewer, bringing the flower, fingers and sleeve visibly over the lower black bar.
After a brief expectant look into the lens, her hopeful smile fades. One eyebrow rises, her head tilts and her eyes search the viewer’s face. Give the flower one small encouraging forward nudge, then accept the implied refusal with a tiny disappointed pout.
Retract the flower and visibly place it outside the side edge of the screen before retrieving the next object.

SECOND OFFER, COFFEE:

Reach offscreen and return with a coffee cup held securely by its handle. Her face brightens with renewed confidence.
Offer the cup close to the lens. Its silhouette and her sleeve clearly overlap the lower black bar while her face remains visible above it.
Her smile falters. Look at the cup, then back into the lens with raised eyebrows and pursed lips. A small resigned shoulder drop follows. Pull the cup back and set it offscreen without spilling.

THIRD OFFER, JEWEL:

Her eyes brighten with a sudden idea. Produce a large sparkling gemstone and present it in an open palm. The gemstone, fingers and sleeve project over the lower black bar.
Look proudly from the jewel to the viewer, expecting success. After the implied rejection, widen her eyes, lift both eyebrows and briefly part her lips in silent disbelief. Give the lens an incredulous stare, press her lips together and put the jewel offscreen.

FOURTH OFFER, CAT:
Retrieve a cute small cat from offscreen, supporting its body with both hands. Present it toward the lens, bringing its front paws, fluffy body and her hands visibly over the lower black bar.
Her expression becomes delighted and persuasive. The cat blinks and moves its paws naturally.
After another implied rejection, her delighted expression collapses into exaggerated disbelief. Look at the cat, then at the viewer, then back at the cat. Squint slightly and form a frustrated pout.
Turn slightly and give the cat a light, comical backward toss. The cat lands on its paws behind her and trots away. Keep this quick and playful.

FINAL OFFER, HERSELF:
Turn back to the viewer. Her frustration changes into a mischievous idea. Raise one index finger in a clear requesting-a-moment gesture, with the fingertip overlapping the upper black bar.
Lift one knee toward the lens and extend her sneaker OVER the lower black bar. The shoe grows large through foreshortening. Her leg crosses the picture boundary in front of the unchanged black surface.
Shift her weight forward and bring the rest of her body after it, as though stepping out of the framed image into the viewer’s space. Her coat overlaps the lower bar while her oversized hat overlaps the upper bar.
The bars remain perfectly straight and stationary beneath her. Her body simply renders in front of them. No opening, bending or displacement of either bar.
Finish close to the lens with open palms presenting herself, lifted eyebrows and a cheeky hopeful smile. Keep natural blinking, breathing and small facial movements through the ending.

OBJECT CONTINUITY:
One offered gift at a time. Show each retrieval, presentation and removal clearly. Objects enter and leave through a side edge of the output. No objects transforming into the next gift or disappearing while still held. Preserve consistent object shapes and natural hand contact.
Brisk natural real-time pacing with readable reactions. No slow motion, frozen expressions, distant retreats or camera movement. No warped bars, duplicated hands, costume changes or text.
Audio consists only of light prop sounds, fabric rustles, sneaker steps and a brief cat meow. No dialogue, human vocalizations or background music.
```

@image1 A cinematic drone camera shot in three distinct staged movements following the numbered yellow guide path on the reference image, in this exact order: STAGE 1 — starting low near her feet, the camera tracks/dollies smoothly across and up along her leg toward her hip, a clear traveling crossing motion along the length of the leg.
